units.label: 1(a)
units.summary: Describe what the BIOS is.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO1 recall description of a named system component.

units.label: 1(b)(i)
units.summary: Name another scheduling algorithm besides first come first served.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark AO1 recall of a listed algorithm name.

units.label: 1(b)(ii)
units.summary: Explain why first come first served suits a router handling packets.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO2 application of FIFO scheduling to a given router context.

units.label: 1(c)
units.summary: Describe one difference between paging and segmentation.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO1 recall of one contrast, mark awarded in a pair.

units.label: 1(d)(i)
units.summary: Describe the Harvard architecture.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO1 recall of separate instruction and data memory and buses.

units.label: 1(d)(ii)
units.summary: Explain why Harvard architecture suits a smart washing machine.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO2 application of the architecture to an embedded device context.

units.label: 1(e)(i)
units.summary: State why removing an external drive must interrupt the fetch-decode-execute cycle.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark AO2 application of interrupts to a given event, open-ended answer.

units.label: 1(e)(ii)
units.summary: Describe how a stack is used when an interrupt service routine handles interrupts.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO1 description linking stack LIFO behaviour to interrupt handling.

units.label: 2(a)
units.summary: State another type of application software and an example use for the vet surgery.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO1/AO2 naming a package and a relevant use, familiar content.

units.label: 2(b)
units.summary: Explain two further utility programs Charlie should install.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark: two utilities each needing a type plus a justified purpose, in context.

units.label: 2(c)
units.summary: Compare open and closed source software and recommend one for the vet database.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extended response needing comparison across five criteria and a justified recommendation.

units.label: 3(a)
units.summary: State what a protocol is.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark AO1 recall of a definition.

units.label: 3(b)(i)
units.summary: Complete a table naming the four TCP/IP layers.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO1 recall of layer names, two blanks.

units.label: 3(b)(ii)
units.summary: Explain one advantage of protocol layering.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO1 recall of a standard benefit of layers.

units.label: 3(c)
units.summary: Discuss benefits and drawbacks of facial recognition identifying customers entering shops.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extended response weighing moral, ethical and legal issues for customers and businesses.

units.label: 4(a)
units.summary: State why computers store data in binary.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark AO1 recall of a single reason.

units.label: 4(b)(i)
units.summary: Convert denary 97 to an 8-bit binary number.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark routine conversion.

units.label: 4(b)(ii)
units.summary: Convert denary 171 to hexadecimal.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark routine conversion.

units.label: 4(b)(iii)
units.summary: Convert denary -97 to 8-bit two's complement.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark routine conversion, familiar procedure.

units.label: 4(b)(iv)
units.summary: Convert denary -17 to 8-bit sign and magnitude.
units.difficulty_basis: 1-mark routine conversion.

units.label: 4(c)
units.summary: State one advantage of two's complement over sign and magnitude.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark AO2 recall of a standard benefit, award 0 or 2.

units.label: 4(d)
units.summary: Add two 8-bit unsigned binary numbers showing working.
units.difficulty_basis: 2-mark routine binary addition, familiar procedure.

units.label: 5(a)
units.summary: Complete a Karnaugh map for a four-variable expression and give the simplified expression.

units.summary: Explain which data type text file values should be converted to.
